entities.name: Luis Alberto Pérez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Luís Alberto Pérez is a Nicaraguan former professional boxer who competed from 1996 to 2014. He held world championships in two weight divisions, including the International Boxing Federation (IBF) super flyweight title from 2003 to 2006, and the IBF bantamweight title in 2007. He also challenged for the WBA super bantamweight interim title in 2008.
